description: This file implements fallback functions for eager tensor operations in the Torch lazy backend, including tensor conversion to eager format, device handling, and operator fallback logic.

methods.name: _to_eager
methods.description: Converts a list of tensors to eager tensors on a specified device, handling undefined tensors separately.

methods.name: to_eager
methods.description: Helper functions to convert tensors or optional tensors to eager tensors, handling undefined tensors.

methods.name: dispatch_key
methods.description: Returns the dispatch key corresponding to a device type.

methods.name: compute_target_device
methods.description: Determines the target device for output tensors based on input tensors and tensor lists.

methods.name: force_eager_fallback
methods.description: Decides whether to force fallback to eager execution for a given operator.

methods.name: ltc_eager_fallback
methods.description: Tracks fallback calls and invokes the eager fallback implementation.

methods.name: register_ts_ltc_eager_fallback
methods.description: Registers the fallback function for lazy tensor core operators.

methods.name: ts_eager_fallback
methods.description: Main fallback implementation that converts inputs, calls the eager operator, and handles aliasing and device transfer for outputs.
